encounter.text: A ratling is slumped against the wall of a side passage, one paw pressed to its side. Its armour — scraps of bent tin and strap leather — is cracked down the middle. It looks up at you with eyes that are weighing something. 'Not with the Brackenfangs,' it says. It's not a question.

choices.text: Demand to know where their gang is.

tended.text: You spend some time on the wound — it's bad but not fatal. When you're done the ratling sits quietly for a moment. 'There's a cache behind the third pipe junction back that way. Kept it from the Fangs. It's yours.' It says nothing else.

provoked.text: The ratling's expression shifts from worn to cold. 'Wrong question.' Despite the wound, it moves fast.

items.name: Tin Shard
items.description: A jagged piece of broken armour, repurposed.
